info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Pro — APIs & Realtime
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Pro — APIs & Realtime.** GraphQL management and delivery APIs, the API explorer, incoming/outgoing webhook extensions and WebSocket realtime tickets.
